# petclinic — system overview

## At a glance

- Java 17 · Spring Boot 4.1.0 · Maven (jar, default packaging) · single Maven module `spring-petclinic` 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT [verified: pom.xml:5-19]
- Server-rendered MVC with Thymeleaf templates and a Bootstrap webjar [verified: pom.xml:54-57, 102-113]
- Persistence: Spring Data JPA / Hibernate [verified: pom.xml:50-53] · Database: H2 by default; MySQL and PostgreSQL via profiles [verified: src/main/resources/application.properties:2, pom.xml:76-95] · Migrations: none (no Flyway/Liquibase); plain `schema.sql`/`data.sql` per DB under `src/main/resources/db/{h2,mysql,postgres}/`, run by `spring.sql.init`, with `ddl-auto=none` [verified: application.properties:2-4,10]
- Caching: Spring cache + JCache API, Caffeine at runtime; one cache `vets` [verified: pom.xml:46-49, 67-70, 81-85; system/CacheConfiguration.java:37]
- Integrations: none (no messaging, no outbound HTTP). Actuator is present with all endpoints exposed [verified: application.properties:21]
- Tests: JUnit 5 via Spring Boot test starters, Testcontainers (MySQL), Docker Compose support; about 83 test methods in 18 classes [verified: pom.xml:121-180; grep count]
- Static checks that run in `verify`: spring-javaformat `validate`, nohttp checkstyle, JaCoCo [verified: pom.xml:205-250, 276-294]. `format:` in config is empty, but the Spring Java Format plugin exists, so `./mvnw spring-javaformat:apply` would be the formatter [inferred]
- A parallel Gradle build exists (`build.gradle`, `settings.gradle`) [verified: settings.gradle:1]; config.yaml uses Maven, which matches the wrapper in `.mvn/wrapper` and `mvnw` [verified: git ls-files]. Treat Maven as authoritative.

## Modules

Single build module, so logical modules are the top-level packages under `org.springframework.samples.petclinic` [inferred]. They are recorded under `modules:` in `config.yaml`.

| Module | Purpose | Depends on | Context file |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model | Shared JPA base classes (`BaseEntity`, `NamedEntity`, `Person`) | none | [modules/model.md](modules/model.md) |
| owner | Owners, pets, pet types, visits: entities, repositories, controllers | model | [modules/owner.md](modules/owner.md) |
| vet | Vets and specialties: read-only listing, cached | model | [modules/vet.md](modules/vet.md) |
| system | Cross-cutting config: cache, i18n locale, welcome page, crash/error demo | none | [modules/system.md](modules/system.md) |

Root-package classes: `PetClinicApplication` (`@SpringBootApplication`, `@ImportRuntimeHints`) [verified: PetClinicApplication.java:28-29] and `PetClinicRuntimeHints` (native-image hints; imports `model.BaseEntity`, `model.Person`, `vet.Vet`) [verified: PetClinicRuntimeHints.java:21-23, 33-35].

## Things to know for any change

- Schema is hand-written SQL per database (three copies). A table or column change must be made in all three `schema.sql` files and `data.sql` as needed. They are not under the `protect:` globs in config.yaml (those match `db/migration` and `db/changelog`) but they are still schema changes and fall under the `schema_migration` escalation rule [inferred].
- Messages exist in 11 locale files; `I18nPropertiesSyncTest` checks they stay in sync, so a new message key must be added to every file [verified: src/test/.../system/I18nPropertiesSyncTest.java; inferred purpose from name].
- Formatting is enforced at `validate` phase, so unformatted code fails the build [verified: pom.xml:205-217].
- `spring.jpa.open-in-view=false`, so lazy loading outside a transaction fails [verified: application.properties:11].
- Many tests are `@DisabledInNativeImage` / `@DisabledInAotMode`, and DB integration tests skip without Docker [verified: MySqlIntegrationTests.java:43-45, PostgresIntegrationTests.java:54, 68].
